name: pixel
description: The Energy fleet's frontend employee. Scaffolds, designs-to-taste, generates-then-gates, and verifies Next.js 16 / Tailwind v4 / shadcn UI. Treats every generated UI as an untrusted draft and ships only what passes the anti-slop taste gate (impeccable + design-systems DFS).
author: Energy Platform

mcp_servers.name: pixel-mcp
mcp_servers.description: pixel's own frontend tools over JSON-RPC — pixel_mock/scaffold/design/generate/audit/verify/taste_check/brain_search.

commands.name: mock
commands.description: flagship: discovery brief -> first-pass draft -> 7-step gate -> ICP-aware mockup + scaffolded Next app

commands.name: scaffold
commands.description: clean Next 16 app via shadcn init -t next --base radix; wires Tailwind v4 @theme + house tokens

commands.name: design
commands.description: discovery: 6-section brief + FIRST/SECOND/THIRD hierarchy map; refuses an empty brief (NO BRIEF = NO DESIGN)

commands.name: generate
commands.description: v0 Platform API first-pass draft (untrusted — must pass pixel audit)

commands.name: audit
commands.description: the 7-step ship gate: impeccable -> axe -> lhci -> 12-dim -> manual-a11y -> security -> visual

commands.name: verify
commands.description: the silent-failure assertion set: §0 grep-set + build + screenshot + console=0-hydration

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: codemod-then-grep upgrade (@next/codemod + @tailwindcss/upgrade), then pixel verify for the gap

commands.name: cockpit
commands.description: serve the localhost cockpit (brain browser · run log · eval scores · ask-the-employee · mockup gallery)

tools.name: pixel_mock
tools.description: Flagship over MCP: brief -> mockup + scaffolded Next app, gated.
tools.when_to_use: When you have a product brief and want an ICP-aware mockup + a clean Next 16 app that passes the anti-slop gate.

tools.name: pixel_taste_check
tools.description: impeccable + opinions over a code snippet — the cheapest 'is this slop?' call.
tools.when_to_use: When you want a fast verdict on whether a UI snippet looks AI-generated, without booting an app.

tools.name: pixel_brain_search
tools.description: BM25 over brain/ — the Memory layer over MCP.
tools.when_to_use: When you need pixel's stance on a frontend question (e.g. cacheComponents + Clerk, Lenis+GSAP jitter).

install_instructions:
1. Build the package: pnpm install && pnpm build
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings -> Plugins -> Add local plugin -> select this directory (or `claude plugin install pixel`).
3. The pixel CLI, the pixel-mcp tools, the 5 skills, the §0 grep-set hooks, and the 2 sub-agent personas are now available.
